sources.entry: CLAUDE.md Writer – AI-powered generator for Claude agent system prompts using a 3-step OpenRouter pipeline

summary.name: CLAUDE.md Writer
summary.one_liner: A free web tool that generates a scored CLAUDE.md system prompt for a Claude AI agent from a plain-language description of the agent.
use_cases: Drafting a CLAUDE.md file for a new Claude agent
Turning a plain description of an agent into a system prompt
Checking and improving the quality of an existing agent prompt
Creating communication rules and constraints for an AI assistant
summary.what_it_does: The page provides a text box where a user describes an AI agent, and the tool runs a generation process. According to the page, it first infers capabilities, iron laws, and constraints, then generates a CLAUDE.md file covering iron laws, communication rules, and memory patterns. It then scores and audits the output and fixes weak areas, returning a score out of 100. The page states that submitted text is processed by OpenRouter's API and not stored or logged. The page text shown is mostly interface status messages, so the exact output format beyond these labels is not documented here.
notable: Three-step pipeline: infer capabilities, generate, then score and improve, via OpenRouter API
Outputs a quality score out of 100 for the generated CLAUDE.md
States submissions are not stored or logged
caveats: Page shows a 'Generation failed' state, so reliability of output is not established
Generation takes roughly 30-90 seconds according to the page
